description: What an hour of one job title is worth at one company, from one date. The rate a NEW Farm Salary Structure starts from: create_salary_structure looks the employee's Designation up here when the caller names no hourly rate, so a Picker hired in March is on the same rate as a Picker hired in June without anybody retyping it. It is a DEFAULT and nothing else — once written onto a structure the number is that worker's, and editing the row here does not reach back and change what an existing structure pays.

fields.description: The job title this rate is the default for. A Link to the site's own Designation register rather than a typed string, because it is matched against Employee.designation and two spellings of 'Irrigator' would be two rates nobody could reconcile.
